test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
A + B means ‘A is the father of B’

A – B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the son of B’

A # B means ‘A is the daughter of B’

If A # B – C @ D + E, then how is A related to E?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png]

Statement given : **A # B – C @ D + E**

So,

 
• A # B → A is the daughter of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa531b02b6dc592b0ac41a070c6a78e3521044ca5b3a17f1e08342c68daa2740.png] 

 
• B – C → B is the mother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/562501f534b72da6dac0e9fe49dae220ffa63cecddf6b6ebf9a9182ccc8db4a4.png] 

 
• C @ D → C is the son of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e18a040e21076055785d9be7400febe499df19bc577b3a6399eed8598c29bd6.png] 

 
• D + E → D is the father of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/870163b56fa4f86b640edbf5638609422b47dc19527fa877c958f7a33ba28414.png] ​

Thus, according to the final family tree, A is the sister of E.

Hence, "Sister" is the correct answer.
